newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee steady on dollar, weakens on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee steady on dollar, weakens on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was steady against the dollar but weakened against the pound sterling on Friday, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 20.9625 to the dollar from 20.9675 on Thursday, and at 35.364 to the pound from 35.0855.
"The rupee's fixing was done in line with dollar's stability against other currencies, and sterling's rise against dollar and German mark on international markets," a dealer said.
